content: I'll split this bead into smaller, focused child beads that sequentially work toward the goal of zero TypeScript errors.

args.command:
bf create --title "Verify TypeScript configuration and project setup" --description "Check and verify TypeScript configuration is properly set up for the project.

Acceptance Criteria:
- tsconfig.json exists and is valid
- TypeScript is installed as a dependency
- All necessary type definition packages are installed
- Configuration includes all project files
- No obvious configuration errors that would prevent compilation" --label split-child
args.description: Create first child bead for TypeScript setup verification

args.command:
bf create --title "Run initial TypeScript compilation and document errors" --description "Execute npx tsc --noEmit and capture all compilation errors for analysis.

Acceptance Criteria:
- npx tsc --noEmit command completes (may have errors)
- All TypeScript errors are captured and documented
- Errors are categorized by file and type
- Total error count is recorded
- Error log is saved for reference" --label split-child
args.description: Create second child bead for running compilation
Add dependency: setup blocks compilation run

args.command:

Acceptance Criteria:
- All TypeScript errors from initial run are addressed
- Type errors are resolved with proper types
- Import errors are fixed
- Missing dependencies are installed
- Each fix is verified locally
- No new errors introduced by fixes" --label split-child
args.description: Create third child bead for fixing errors

output: Added dependency: bf-2i2ie depends on bf-23rm8 (blocks)

args.command:
bf create --title "Verify zero TypeScript errors" --description "Run final TypeScript compilation to verify zero errors across the entire project.

Acceptance Criteria:
- npx tsc --noEmit executes successfully
- Zero TypeScript errors reported
- Compilation completes without warnings about missing types
- All project files compile cleanly
- No type mismatches or invalid constructs remain" --label split-child
args.description: Create fourth child bead for final verification
Add dependency: fixes blocks final verification
